rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2BB label and gives a plausible ICM/TE description, but it incorrectly equates Gardner 2 with a full blastocyst and adds image-specific claims about zona thinning and exact pole location that are not clearly supportable.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrium, first-cycle status, and lifestyle with embryo quality to contextualize prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from morphology and patient factors to prognosis, though the numeric adjustment scheme is somewhat subjective and based partly on an expansion-stage misinterpretation.

Mostly aligned on SET and general transfer planning, but there are notable deviations: misstatement of Gardner expansion criteria, overemphasis on BMI 19 as a concern, and somewhat liberal endorsement of PGT-A/ERA considerations without strong indication in this first-cycle good-prognosis patient.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer, luteal support, SET, cryopreservation review, and contingency planning, though some suggestions are more generic than case-essential.
